verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official MCP server that lets developers connect their chosen LLM client to Adyen's platform using natural language, and a probe confirms the documentation page exists. The pack does not show which tools it exposes, whether it covers the in-person Terminal API, or how to set it up, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: documented tool list and scope (especially in-person/Terminal API operations), setup and authentication details, independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent connecting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Our Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets you use natural language with your chosen Large Language Model (LLM) client.
This allows developers to use natural language to connect with Adyen's platform more easily and build new payment solutions faster.
